_comment_: Real-harness baseline for provider-quirks-openai.hcl, minimised from a live CI run on 2026-07-30 (GitHub Actions run 30581229175, source runId eval-1785445414694, 5/5). Models are pinned by the suite itself — openai/gpt-5.6-terra for the terra-* tasks, openai/gpt-5.6-sol for the sol-* tasks, both over OpenRouter — NOT by the eval-gate's --model, which CI deliberately withholds from provider-quirks-* suites. Regenerate by re-running the suite with no --model/--provider/--base-url override and re-minimising. Traces, timings, and temp paths are intentionally omitted to keep the baseline deterministic; the compare step gates on per-task outcome only. NOTE ON judgeVerdict.reason: the sub-judge counts below are a property of the suite's judge blocks, not of the run — changing a task's judges changes the reason string and requires regenerating this file even when behaviour is unchanged. The tool-call SEQUENCE is deliberately not baselined: it varies legitimately between runs (the first live run of this suite used edit_file where the second used run_command for the same task), which is why the judges assert end state rather than tool choice — see the header of the .hcl.
